part.head: Head (throat sac)
opening.perch: Resting on a perch — attack now
opening.recover: Pulling up after a dive — attack now
opening.hover: Nearly still while charging — attack now
broken.wingL: Left wing broken: slower and lower, no gust or dive
broken.wingR: Right wing broken: slower and lower, no gust or dive
broken.head: Throat sac broken: no lightning orbs
broken.tail: Tail broken: wider turns, no tail sweep
broken.both: Both wings broken: it falls to the ground to rest
phase3: STORM: five orbs per volley. Time limit {time}
briefing: Nephirga, a giant storm-wrapped pterosaur, circles above the harbor city. Turn inside its circle to catch it.
Tells: hovering with a glowing throat → lightning orbs (break hard sideways or flare); wings raised → gust ahead; sharp climb → dive (turn at a right angle); tail curled → sweep behind.
Attack while it rests on a perch, while it pulls up after a dive, and during tells. Breaking a wing makes it slower and lower; the head stops the orbs and the tail stops the sweep.
Below 40% health the storm begins (4.5 min, Hard 4 min). If it is not down within the overall limit (12 min, Hard 10 min), the storm hits the city.
